exposure: Fetal amnioinfusion for bilateral renal agenesis or bladder outlet obstruction
outcome: Mortality (30-day, 1-year, day one of life, 3 months)
Complications (difficulty retaining intra-amniotic fluid, peritoneal dialysis failure)
cohort: The study included 5 fetuses with bilateral renal agenesis or bladder outlet obstruction who received fetal amnioinfusion at the Colorado Fetal Care Center between 2013 and 2019.
finding: Fetal amnioinfusion for renal agenesis or bladder outlet obstruction is associated with high morbidity (difficulty retaining fluid, dialysis complications) and mortality (60% 30-day, 80% 1-year) despite the potential for survival.
